_comment: Machine capacity for this box — how much work it can chew at once. Experiment DESIGN (which legs, parallel legs, cost/step guards) stays in combinations/*.json and the yaml configs. Env vars and CLI flags still override per-run.
_retry: How long a leg waits out API rate limiting before an instance dies with RateLimitError and an empty patch. Backoff caps at 60s, so attempts are roughly minutes. High-effort legs get far longer: their requests are large and slow, they burn a token-per-minute budget faster, and a fable-5 max leg lost 80 of 105 instances this way — the run is void, not just delayed, so waiting is always cheaper than re-running.
